big_case.notes: Granted, plenary, on the SG's reformulated question: whether Section 11(a) misleading-omissions liability can rest on the materiality of undisclosed interim financial data without a separate misleadingness inquiry. It bears on every registered offering and on IPO litigation exposure; the SEC joined the SG's brief and SIFMA/Chamber filed at the cert stage. A technical statutory securities case with high stakes for the securities bar and issuers and low general public salience.
